## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Halton low-discrepancy scattering through a volume: Count quasi-random
// points from radical inverses in bases BaseX, BaseY and BaseZ, which must be
// pairwise coprime (typically 2, 3 and 5)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halton_sequence).
type HaltonPattern3D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds3D;
    Count: Integer;
    BaseX: Integer;
    BaseY: Integer;
    BaseZ: Integer;
}

// Plastic (R3) low-discrepancy scattering through a volume: Count terms of the
// additive recurrence whose three increments are the reciprocal powers of the
// positive root of x^4 = x + 1, offset by Offset in [0, 1).
type PlasticPattern3D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds3D;
    Count: Integer;
    Offset: Number;
}

//==
// # Interpolation and resampling
//
// How values between grid samples are reconstructed, how coordinates outside
// a grid are treated, and the descriptors for transferring values from one
// regular grid onto another.

// How values between grid samples are reconstructed
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multivariate_interpolation).
type InterpolationScheme
    = Nearest
    | Linear
    | Bilinear
    | Bicubic
    | Trilinear
    | Tricubic
    | CatmullRom
    | CubicBSpline;

// How a sampled grid treats coordinates outside its bounds: clamp to the
// edge value, tile, reflect, or read zero.
type GridBoundary = ClampToEdge | Wrap | Mirror | ZeroOutside;

// A reconstruction policy for sampled grids: which interpolation scheme to
// use between nodes and how to treat out-of-bounds coordinates.
type GridSamplingScheme
    implements IValue
{
    Interpolation: InterpolationScheme;
    Boundary: GridBoundary;
}

// A planar resampling operation: values defined on Source are transferred
// onto the nodes of Target using the given sampling scheme.
type GridResampling2D
    implements IValue
{
    Source: RegularGrid2D;
    Target: RegularGrid2D;
    Scheme: GridSamplingScheme;
}

// A spatial resampling operation: values defined on Source are transferred
// onto the nodes of Target using the given sampling scheme.
type GridResampling3D
    implements IValue
{
    Source: RegularGrid3D;
    Target: RegularGrid3D;
    Scheme: GridSamplingScheme;
}
```
